0|c6ec76a2ebc5829e5826b218d2e1475ec11b333e|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"mm: add pte_batch_hint() to reduce scanning in folio_pte_batch()
Some architectures (e.g.  arm64) can tell from looking at a pte
follow-on ptes also map contiguous physical memory with the same pgprot.
Take advantage of this knowledge to optimize folio_pte_batch() so that it
can skip these ptes when scanning to create a batch.  By default
changes are optimized out and the behaviour is as before.
arm64 will opt-in to providing this hint in the next patch
greatly reduce the cost of ptep_get() when scanning a range of contptes.
